objective: Improve root candidate recall at exactly 64 visits with the current unchanged-size model; measure candidate inclusion separately from evaluation and final move selection.

variants.rootCandidates: top 8 eligible actions by unchanged mixed prior
top 16 eligible actions by unchanged mixed prior
keep top 8; add up to 4 distinct eligible tactical actions from outside top 8; maximum 12

tactical.eligible: non-pass legal actions surviving existing root masks; post-move new chain has at least 2 liberties
tactical.score: captured stones + unique friendly vulnerable-chain stones continued + max(0, distinct adjacent friendly chains joined - 1)
tactical.vulnerableChain: before the move, friendly chain has 1 or 2 liberties; action is an original liberty and the surviving joined chain has at least 2 liberties after the move; this is a candidate heuristic, not a proof of survival
tactical.counting: each pre-move friendly chain counted once; require score > 0
tactical.ordering: score descending, unchanged root prior descending, existing seeded root order
tactical.scope: candidate membership only; no logit/prior/value bonus and no overrides of pass, proof, legality, superko or existing masks

invariants: Same frozen neural model and exact 64 completed visits except the existing certified-loss early stop.
All first-round candidates receive at least one visit before halving; preserve pending reservations, cancellation and arbitrary budget behavior.
Child PUCT, FPU, Q scale, prior mixture, exact terminal proof and root guards remain unchanged.
Candidate generation uses graph neighbors/groups; no plane coordinates, vertex-number preference or L6 special case.
All added evaluations and terminal backups count within 64; no hidden NN pre-screen outside the budget.

reportedFixture.passCondition: C8plus4 includes and visits L6 and selects L6 at 64 visits for all 8 diagnostic seeds on native CPU; browser numeric/choice differences must be investigated before release
reportedFixture.note: Prior-promotion results in the conversation are synthetic diagnostics, not measurements of B16 or C8plus4.

corpus.generator: fresh A8 selfplay, separate from all historical holdout games
corpus.rootPlies: floor(N/4), floor(N/2), floor(3*N/4), N, where N is board points
corpus.missingRoot: record absence; never replace a short game or resample based on outcome
corpus.splitUnit: whole origin game and all symmetries/relabelings
corpus.teacher: plane roots only: existing KataGo network 3d8a24697ba25fe4da39af4c2b6bd405907b0ad8295322f5a550fa2d8fe4a2f4, same rules, 4096 visits, noise-free; store outputs and binary/config hashes; curved roots have no KataGo labels

metrics: initial candidate IDs/count and per-action addition reason
fraction of roots with a candidate-set change, added moves, and a final selected added move
teacher best-action inclusion and teacher policy mass included, on plane roots
teacher best-action visits and final selection conditional on inclusion
root original policy rank, mixed prior, raw visits, Q, final comparison score/policy, eliminated round and selected action
NN batches/evaluations, completed visits, root-heuristic CPU time and total latency
diagnostics.interpretation: Diagnostic metrics explain mechanisms; they do not substitute for independent playing strength. Holdout outputs remain unopened until code/config selection is frozen.

checks: exact visit accounting including terminal evaluations
changed-candidate and added-move counters work on fixed adversarial roots

development.selection: Eligible candidate with highest overall match score; tie prefers smaller maximum candidate set (C8plus4). Candidate must score at least 40/72, each board at least 3/8, pass fixture/correctness/speed preflight, and have no illegal or capped games. If none passes, stop and retain A8.
development.freeze: Record selected source, binary, model, seeds, fixture manifest and config hashes before inspecting any holdout output.

independent.opponent: A8; only the single frozen selected candidate is tested
independent.resamplingUnit: colour-swapped opening pair, stratified by board
independent.interpretation: Plane/curve/individual-board conditions are safeguards with finite power; per-board point thresholds do not prove per-board non-inferiority. Failure or uncertainty is not permission to increase the sample or change settings.

matches.backend: native CPU/ONNX and production search WASM for fixed-budget strength; actual Worker backends for correctness/latency
matches.opening: same 4 legal moves from an independent per-pair RNG, shared by both colour-swapped games and variants; enumerate opening histories/seeds before play; use existing opening sampler after compatibility audit
matches.outcome: actual app Game area score; draw = half point
matches.seedDerivation: FNV1a32 of phase seed, board key, pair index and ply; same per-ply search seed across swapped games; zero maps to 1
matches.retries: Infrastructure retries retain original seed, input and all attempt logs; never replace an outcome or capped game.

speed.fixture: Freeze 3 fresh ordinary roots per board (27) plus reported-game, maximum-candidate and proof/pass stress roots, before timing; use fresh independent canary origins, no outcome-based choice
speed.ordering: paired alternating A/B order in the same environment
speed.measurement: full restore + root-candidate generation + search + NN inference + normal yields, excluding initialization/rendering and diagnostic logging; report sample sizes and observed P95
speed.mobile: Pixel 8a WASM and WebGPU device timing required before changing default; unavailable device means leave release gate pending, not an assumed pass

implementation.work: parameterized root membership and correct halving for 8, 12 and 16 candidates; preserve finite/incremental budget semantics
bounded graph-based add-only tactical candidates separate from existing negative pruning
development diagnostics for candidate membership, additions and elimination; version diagnostic layout if it changes, retain old readers or update together
proposed, not implemented: freeze artifacts, reproduce fixture, collect diagnostics and run predeclared stages
reuse production Worker measurement and extend to all 9 boards and selected search binary

three research binaries, candidate instrumentation and semantic tests
milestones.gate: fixture, masking, budgeting, proofs and canaries pass

milestones.gate: select at most one candidate using fixed rule, or stop

CPU/WebGPU/mobile timing, Worker regression, final report and releasable artifact

phase2.goal: Improve policy recall with fresh teacher labels after search effects have been measured separately.
phase2.design: Freeze stage-1 search. Collect normal and low-recall plane roots from fresh games, label with KataGo, and retain representative curve replay. Compare teacher-policy fine-tuning with a matched extra-training control on identical roots, WDL/score/ownership labels, splits, optimizer and compute. Keep 64x6/120905 parameters. Use origin-game splits and common teacher validation. Evaluate candidate model with old and selected searches to report search, learning and combined effects.
phase2.beforeExecution: Register game IDs/counts, curriculum weighting, teacher visits, optimizer, epochs, model selection, independent samples/seeds and adoption criteria before collecting labels or training; no stage-1 holdout or reported-game data in training.
phase2.reason: Avoid tuning both search and weights on the same observed outcome.

stopConditions: artifact/hash drift without a new recorded plan revision
legality, terminal proof, mask, budget, cancellation or numeric semantic failure
holdout leakage; regenerate a genuinely fresh evaluation plan before further claims
outputPolicy: Use a fresh workspace and append immutable commands, inputs, hashes, raw logs, full games and reports. Do not overwrite historical experiments. This task creates the plan only; it does not run the study, install binaries, update model weights, commit or deploy.
